key highlights |url=https://www.livemint.com/market/stock-market-news/zee-entertainment-q4-results-firm-reports-net-loss-of-rs-196-crore-revenue-down-9-11685015450251.html |work=mint}} | net_income = {{loss}} {{INRConvert|-196|c}} (2022) | assets = {{loss}} {{INRConvert|13239|c}} (2022) | num_employees = 3,429 (2021) | parent = [[Essel Group]] | footnotes = {{Cite web |date=6 May 2019 |title=Zee's FY19 earnings may aid better valuation |url=https://www.fortuneindia.com/enterprise/zees-fy19-earnings-may-aid-better-valuation/103259 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210522062015/https://www.fortuneindia.com/enterprise/zees-fy19-earnings-may-aid-better-valuation/103259 |archive-date=22 May 2021 |access-date=24 December 2020 |website=www.fortuneindia.com}} | website = {{URL|https://www.zee.com/|zee.com}} }} '''Zee Entertainment Enterprises Limited''' ('''ZEEL''') is an Indian [[media conglomerate]]. Headquartered in [[Mumbai]], it has interests in television, print, internet, film, and businesses related to mobile content, and operates 35 channels worldwide. == History == === Independent era === [[File:Zee entertainment enterprises logo.svg|thumb|Logo used from 2017 to 2025]] In April 1995, the company launched the [[Pay television|premium movie channel]] Zee Cinema, the first channel of its sort in the country.{{Cite web |title=Zee Cinema celebrates 20 years of winning hearts |url=http://www.tellychakkar.com/tv/tv-news/zee-cinema-celebrates-20-years-of-winning-hearts-557 |access-date=2023-08-18 |website=Tellychakkar.com |language=en}}{{Cite web |title=Zee Entertainment Enterprises History |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/zee-entertainment-enterprises-ltd/infocompanyhistory/companyid-11769.cms |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210725161938/https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/zee-entertainment-enterprises-ltd/infocompanyhistory/companyid-11769.cms |archive-date=25 July 2021 |access-date=26 February 2020 |website=[[The Economic Times]]}}{{Cite web |last=Singh |first=Suhani |date=21 August 2017 |title=Entertainment Inc.: The story of Zee, one of India's first Hindi {{sic|satel|ite|nolink=y}} channels |url=https://www.indiatoday.in/magazine/cover-story/story/20170821-zee-hindi-tv-channel-subhash-chandra-1028931-2017-08-11 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180312211846/https://www.indiatoday.in/magazine/cover-story/story/20170821-zee-hindi-tv-channel-subhash-chandra-1028931-2017-08-11 |archive-date=12 March 2018 |access-date=26 February 2020 |website=[[India Today]] |language=en}} Until 1999, programming was done by [[Disney Star|Star TV]]. In the following years Zee Cinema has also catered to international markets like South-East America, Europe, Middle East, North Africa, Pakistan, Indonesia{{Cite web |title=Zee Cinema launched in Indonesia |url=https://www.zee.com/in-the-news/zee-cinema-launched-in-indonesia/ |website=www.Zee.com}} and [[Asia Pacific]] and the Rest of [[Africa]].{{citation needed|date=August 2023}} [[Zee Cinema (Canada)]] is available in Canada as a joint ventures with Ethnic Group. Zee Telefilms launched a [[Nickelodeon]]-branded programming block in 1999 as part of a distribution deal between [[Viacom International]] and Zee Telefilms. It was replaced by a new [[Cartoon Network India|Cartoon Network]] block in 2002.{{cite web |date=11 October 1999 |title=ZEE TV TO LAUNCH NICKELODEON |url=http://www.indiantelevision.com/news_analysis/newsletter/111099/zee111099.htm |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170323085148/http://www.indiantelevision.com/news_analysis/newsletter/111099/zee111099.htm |archive-date=23 March 2017 |access-date=21 June 2017}}{{cite web |date=14 August 2002 |title=Cartoon Network block replaces Nick on Zee TV |url=http://www.indiantelevision.com/y2k2/aug/aug87.htm |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170902123040/http://www.indiantelevision.com/y2k2/aug/aug87.htm |archive-date=2 September 2017 |access-date=19 September 2017 |work=Indian Television Dot Com}} In 2008, Zee Networks launched [[Zee Motion Pictures]] and [[Zee Limelight]] (now [[Zee Studios]]) for the development, production, distribution and marketing of mainstream films in Indian languages, including [[Hindi language|Hindi]], [[Malayalam language|Malayalam]], [[Tamil language|Tamil]], [[Telugu language|Telugu]], [[Kannada language|Kannada]], [[Bengali language|Bengali]] and [[Marathi language|Marathi]].{{cite news |date=2008 |title=Zee Group launches two motion picture production banners |url=https://businessofcinema.com/bollywood-news/zee-group-launches-two-motion-picture-production-banners/22232 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171107024651/https://businessofcinema.com/bollywood-news/zee-group-launches-two-motion-picture-production-banners/22232 |archive-date=7 November 2017 |access-date=2 November 2017 |publisher=Business of Cinema}} In 2015, Zee acquired Sarthak TV, an [[Odia language|Odia]]-language pay television channel.{{Cite web |date=15 July 2015 |title=Zee Entertainment acquires Sarthak Entertainment - Exchange4media |url=https://www.exchange4media.com/media-tv-news/zee-entertainment-acquires-sarthak-entertainment-60810.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211025210359/https://www.exchange4media.com/media-tv-news/zee-entertainment-acquires-sarthak-entertainment-60810.html |archive-date=25 October 2021 |access-date=6 September 2021 |website=Indian Advertising Media & Marketing News – exchange4media}} In 2017, the company acquired the majority stake of the Reliance Broadcast Network.{{cite web |author=Bindu D Menon |date=23 November 2016 |title=Zee buys Anil Ambani's TV, radio biz for ₹1,900 cr | Business Line |url=http://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/zee-group-buys-into-anil-ambanis-tv-and-radio-businesses/article9378020.ece |access-date=2017-11-23 |publisher=Thehindubusinessline.com}} It also planned to acquire [[9X Media]] in October 2017 for the cost of {{INR}}160 [[crore]], however, the plan fell through in March 2018.{{Cite news |date=2017-10-06 |title=Zee to acquire 9X Media, its arms for ₹160 cr |url=http://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/zee-entertainment-fully-acquires-9x-media-and-inx-music/article9891227.ece |access-date=2017-11-18 |work=The Hindu Business Line |language=en}}{{Cite news |title=ZEE terminates 9X Media acquisition |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/media/entertainment/zee-terminates-9x-media-acquisition/articleshow/63334878.cms?from=mdr |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210523051348/https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/media/entertainment/zee-terminates-9x-media-acquisition/articleshow/63334878.cms?from=mdr |archive-date=23 May 2021 |access-date=23 May 2021 |language=en}} A partially owned subsidiary, Diligent Media Corporation, is a publisher of Indian daily newspapers and websites. DMC is a [[joint venture]] between Zee and the [[Dainik Bhaskar]] Group.{{cite web |title=Indian Newspapers and News Sites |url=http://www.w3newspapers.com/india/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210407124626/https://www.w3newspapers.com/india/ |archive-date=7 April 2021 |access-date=18 October 2014 |website=w3newspapers.com}} In 2018, Zee launched [[Zee Theatre]], which offers a collection of recorded theatre plays also called teleplay- produced in India and internationally.{{Cite news |last=IANS |date=2017-01-10 |title=Zee Theatre to take 12 plays to 15 Indian cities |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/news-ians/zee-theatre-to-take-12-plays-to-15-indian-cities-117011000552_1.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221002113143/https://www.business-standard.com/article/news-ians/zee-theatre-to-take-12-plays-to-15-indian-cities-117011000552_1.html |archive-date=2 October 2022 |access-date=2022-10-02 |work=Business Standard India}} === Sale talks === In February 2019, media reported that [[Essel Group]] was in talks to sell their shares from the Zee Entertainment Enterprises to save them from debt.{{Cite news |last1=Laghate |first1=Gaurav |last2=Barman |first2=Arijit |title=Zee Entertainment: Comcast-Atairos, Sony shortlisted for stake sale talks by Zee Entertainment |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/media/entertainment/media/comcast-atairos-sony-shortlisted-for-stake-sale-talks-by-zee-entertainment/articleshow/68056312.cms |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190403145906/https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/media/entertainment/media/comcast-atairos-sony-shortlisted-for-stake-sale-talks-by-zee-entertainment/articleshow/68056312.cms |archive-date=3 April 2019 |access-date=3 April 2019 |newspaper=The Economic Times}} Top Sony officials including Mike Hopkins, chairman of Sony Pictures Television, and [[Tony Vinciquerra]], chairman of [[Sony Pictures]], had visited [[Subhash Chandra]] and his family at his residence shortly after Chandra announced his intent to sell half of the promoter holding in Zee Entertainment Enterprises to a global strategic investor.
On 2 April reports said that{{Cite news |title=Zee Entertainment shares wobble after share sale by promoters |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/zee-entertainment-shares-wobble-after-share-sale-by-promoters/articleshow/68681842.cms |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190403133745/https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/zee-entertainment-shares-wobble-after-share-sale-by-promoters/articleshow/68681842.cms |archive-date=3 April 2019 |access-date=3 April 2019 |newspaper=The Economic Times}} some other promoters{{Cite web |date=2 April 2019 |title=Zee Entertainment Down 3% After Promoters Sell Stake |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/stocks/zee-entertainment-down-3-after-promoters-sell-stake-3744761.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190403124024/https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/stocks/zee-entertainment-down-3-after-promoters-sell-stake-3744761.html |archive-date=3 April 2019 |access-date=3 April 2019 |website=Moneycontrol}} were willing to sell their shares worth {{INR}}332 crore.
On 3 April media reported the Sony and Zee Entertainment Enterprises deal was off.{{Cite news |last1=Laghate |first1=Gaurav |last2=Barman |first2=Arijit |title=Sony Corporation: Sony, ZEE deal off for now amid valuation differences |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/media/entertainment/sony-zee-deal-off-for-now-amid-valuation-differences/articleshow/68697156.cms |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190403133713/https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/media/entertainment/sony-zee-deal-off-for-now-amid-valuation-differences/articleshow/68697156.cms |archive-date=3 April 2019 |access-date=3 April 2019 |newspaper=The Economic Times}} On 1 August media reports [[Invesco]] Oppenheimer Fund to buy 11% stake in Zee Entertainment.{{Cite web |last=Thomas |first=Tanya |date=31 July 2019 |title=Invesco Oppenheimer fund to buy 11% stake in Zee Entertainment for ₹4,224 cr |url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/invesco-oppenheimer-fund-to-buy-11-in-zeel-for-rs-4-224-crore-1564577772129.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210906042442/https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/invesco-oppenheimer-fund-to-buy-11-in-zeel-for-rs-4-224-crore-1564577772129.html |archive-date=6 September 2021 |access-date=6 September 2021 |website=www.livemint.com}} In September 2021, it was reported that [[Invesco]] Developing Markets Funds and OFI Global China Fund LLC, who jointly holds a 17.88% stake, wanted [[Punit Goenka]] (also the son of founder) to step down as MD and CEO. It was also reported that [[Essel Group]] owns a sum of 3.99% minority stake.{{Cite web |date=15 September 2021 |title=Investors want MD Punit Goenka out of Zee Entertainment Enterprises - the New Indian Express |url=https://www.newindianexpress.com/business/2021/Sep/15/investors-want-md-punit-goenka-out-ofzee-entertainment-enterprises-2358877.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211010192405/https://www.newindianexpress.com/business/2021/sep/15/investors-want-md-punit-goenka-out-ofzee-entertainment-enterprises-2358877.amp |archive-date=10 October 2021 |access-date=10 October 2021}} In 2024, Zee Entertainment Enterprises partnered with Sony Pictures Entertainment.{{cite web |title=Sony on the Hunt for Indian Partner After Zee Deal Fades |url=https://www.brutimes.com/news/business/sony-on-the-hunt-for-indian-partner-after-zee-deal-fades |website=Bru Times News |language=en}} ==== Attempted merger with Sony Pictures Networks India ==== On 22 September 2021, the company announced its intent to merge with [[Culver Max Entertainment|Sony Pictures Networks India]].{{Cite web |title=Sony Pictures India to Merge With Zee Entertainment |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/business/business-news/zee-to-merge-with-sony-pictures-india-1235018372 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210922151655/https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/business/business-news/zee-to-merge-with-sony-pictures-india-1235018372/ |archive-date=22 September 2021 |access-date=2021-09-21 |website=The Hollywood Reporter |language=en}} Sony Pictures will hold a majority stake in the proposed merged entity, which will be headed by Zee's Punit Goenka.{{Cite web |date=22 September 2021 |title=Zee Entertainment Approves In-principle Merger With Sony Pictures India |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/companies/zee-entertainment-signs-merger-deal-with-sony-pictures-india-7492871.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211021143533/https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/companies/zee-entertainment-signs-merger-deal-with-sony-pictures-india-7492871.html |archive-date=21 October 2021 |access-date=2021-10-21 |website=Moneycontrol |language=en}} In December 2021, the merger was approved by the two companies boards. Sony will hold a stake close to 51% in the company, with Zee controlling the remaining stake.{{cite web |date=22 December 2021 |title=Sony Pictures Networks, Zee Complete Merger to Create Indian TV Giant |url=https://variety.com/2021/global/news/sony-pictures-networks-zee-merger-complete-1235140626/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211222033806/https://variety.com/2021/global/news/sony-pictures-networks-zee-merger-complete-1235140626/ |archive-date=22 December 2021 |access-date=22 December 2021 |website=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]]}} On 10 August 2023, the [[National Company Law Tribunal]] approved the proposed Sony/Zee merger.{{Cite web |last1=Ramachandran |first1=Naman |last2=Frater |first2=Patrick |date=2023-08-10 |title=Sony-Zee TV Mega Merger in India Is Given Green Light |url=https://variety.com/2023/tv/asia/sony-zee-tv-merger-in-india-1235692955/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230820232829/https://variety.com/2023/tv/asia/sony-zee-tv-merger-in-india-1235692955/ |archive-date=2023-08-20 |access-date=2023-10-07 |website=Variety |language=en-US}} On 18 January 2024, the anticipated $10 billion merger between Zee Entertainment Enterprises and Sony Pictures India progressed as ZEE's stock increased amid reports that CEO [[Punit Goenka]] might step down, potentially resolving a major deadlock in the merger process.{{Cite web |date=2024-01-18 |title=ZEE-Sony merger: ZEEL stock surges as Goenka on expectations Goenka may step down as CEO {{!}} Know more |url=https://www.news9live.com/business/companies/zee-sony-merger-zeel-stock-surges-as-goenka-on-expectations-goenka-may-step-down-as-ceo-know-more-2409851 |access-date=2024-01-18 |website=News9live |language=en-US}} However, on 22 January 2024, Sony Pictures Networks India issued a notice to Zee Entertainment Enterprises effectively terminating the merger proceedings due to, among other reasons, the closing conditions to the merger not being satisfied by the given deadline of 21 January.{{cite web |last1=Frater |first1=Patrick |last2=Ramachandran |first2=Naman |date=22 January 2024 |title=Sony Calls Off $10 Billion Merger With Indian TV Giant Zee Entertainment Enterprises |url=https://variety.com/2024/tv/news/sony-zee-india-deal-halted-1235865873/ |access-date=22 January 2024 |website=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]]}} == Controversy == === Dispute between promoters === On 11 September 2021, Invesco asked Zee management to call shareholders an "extraordinary general meeting" (EGM) to consider its demands. One of the main demands was the removal of [[Punit Goenka]], son of the Zee Network founder.{{Cite web |date=13 September 2021 |title=Zee Entertainment's Largest Shareholders Call EGM Seeking Removal Of Punit Goenka From Board |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/corporate-action/zees-largest-shareholders-calls-for-egm-seeking-removal-of-punit-goenka-from-board-7463111.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211021142600/https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/corporate-action/zees-largest-shareholders-calls-for-egm-seeking-removal-of-punit-goenka-from-board-7463111.html |archive-date=21 October 2021 |access-date=2021-10-21 |website=Moneycontrol |language=en}} However Zee board rejects a demand from Invesco to convene an extraordinary general meeting.{{Cite web |date=October 2021 |title=Zee Says Will Not Hold EGM As Demanded By Shareholder Invesco |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/zee-says-will-not-hold-egm-as-demanded-by-shareholder-invesco-7531081.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211021142602/https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/zee-says-will-not-hold-egm-as-demanded-by-shareholder-invesco-7531081.html |archive-date=21 October 2021 |access-date=2021-10-21 |website=Moneycontrol |language=en}} Invesco Developing Market Funds Moves to National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) and [[Bombay High Court]] seeking a mandatory order for Zee Enterprises Entertainment Limited (ZEEL) to call the extraordinary general meeting (EGM) that the shareholder has been demanding.{{Cite web |date=4 October 2021 |title=Zee-Invesco NCLT Hearing: Invesco Says NCLT Must Make A Mandatory Order To Call EGM |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/zee-invesco-nclt-hearing-not-concerned-about-outcome-of-egm-but-about-egm-being-called-says-invesco-7541121.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211021142604/https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/zee-invesco-nclt-hearing-not-concerned-about-outcome-of-egm-but-about-egm-being-called-says-invesco-7541121.html |archive-date=21 October 2021 |access-date=2021-10-21 |website=Moneycontrol |language=en}}{{Cite news |last=Chatterjee |first=Sudipto Dey & Dev |date=2021-10-04 |title=Prolonged battle ahead as ZEE Entertainment takes Invesco to court |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/prolonged-battle-ahead-as-zee-entertainment-takes-invesco-to-court-121100400032_1.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211021142600/https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/prolonged-battle-ahead-as-zee-entertainment-takes-invesco-to-court-121100400032_1.html |archive-date=21 October 2021 |access-date=2021-10-21 |work=Business Standard India}} Zee Board replied to Invesco's open letter saying they didn't care about the company, and Invesco was not motivated by concerns related to any corporate governance issue{{Cite web |date=13 October 2021 |title=Zee Hits Back At Invesco's Open Letter, Rebuts Objections On Sony Merger Deal |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/companies/zee-hits-back-at-invescos-open-letter-rebuts-objections-on-sony-merger-deal-7579641.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211021142600/https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/companies/zee-hits-back-at-invescos-open-letter-rebuts-objections-on-sony-merger-deal-7579641.html |archive-date=21 October 2021 |access-date=2021-10-21 |website=Moneycontrol |language=en}} but "by the events that transpired during February–April 2021 pointing Invesco purposed deal with [[Reliance Industries]].{{Cite web |date=12 October 2021 |title=Invesco Proposed Merger With Large Indian Group In Feb 2021, Wanted Punit Goenka To Lead: Zee |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/companies/invesco-proposed-merger-with-large-indian-group-in-feb-2021-wanted-punit-goenka-to-lead-zee-7575661.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211021142603/https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/companies/invesco-proposed-merger-with-large-indian-group-in-feb-2021-wanted-punit-goenka-to-lead-zee-7575661.html |archive-date=21 October 2021 |access-date=2021-10-21 |website=Moneycontrol |language=en}} On 21 October, [[Bombay High Court]] asked the Zee board to call EGM as demanded by shareholder Invesco, and Counsel appearing for Zee Entertainment said the company will inform the date of the EGM by the morning of 22 October.{{Cite web |date=21 October 2021 |title=Bombay HC Asks Zee To Call EGM As Demanded By Shareholder Invesco |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/companies/bombay-hc-asks-zee-to-call-egm-as-demanded-by-shareholder-invesco-7608931.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211021142606/https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/companies/bombay-hc-asks-zee-to-call-egm-as-demanded-by-shareholder-invesco-7608931.html |archive-date=21 October 2021 |access-date=2021-10-21 |website=Moneycontrol |language=en}}{{Cite web |last=Upadhyay |first=Payaswini |date=21 October 2021 |title=Zee Vs Invesco: Bombay High Court Proposes To Allow EGM, But... |url=https://www.bloombergquint.com/law-and-policy/zee-vs-invesco-bombay-high-court-proposes-to-allow-egm-but |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211021142602/https://www.bloombergquint.com/law-and-policy/zee-vs-invesco-bombay-high-court-proposes-to-allow-egm-but |archive-date=21 October 2021 |access-date=2021-10-21 |website=BloombergQuint |language=en}} On 22 October, Zee replied to the court that the board can't give a nod to something that will turn out to be illegal,{{Cite web |date=22
